annotations.text:
HOME — the deck is the point; give it the screen.
Fix: pull the hero up, bleed the deck to the gutter, grow the play + fader targets past 44px.
System: name shrinks to a label, the crate prompt gets loud, the pitch fader goes horizontal below the platter.

ABOUT — half a screen of content, centred prose, three of six facts.
Fix: left-align the bio, wrap the pills into one tag row so all six facts fit, trim the height.
System: portrait becomes a header avatar; facts become a 2-up card grid; the section is only as tall as its content.

EXPERIENCE — one card, no swipe hint, ~230px of void.
Fix: year tag onto the card, next card peeking, a dot row.
System: drop the filmstrip on phones — a vertical timeline of six compact rows fills the section on its own.

MY TASTE — three labels, two swipe rows, two dot sets, big voids between zones.
Fix: close the voids, snap the rows to the gutter so cards aren't sliced on both edges.
System: one swipe row for artists; the top 5 becomes a numbered list — a ranking wants to be vertical.

PROJECTS — title and role are two columns that wrap independently into a tangle.
Fix: single column, role as a mono kicker above a one-line title, chevron right.
System: cards with a one-line preview in the collapsed state (today you get nothing until you tap).

CONNECT — works, but the cassette chrome is loud and the min-height pushes the footer away.
Fix: tighten spacing, 44px inputs, full-width send.
System: chrome down to a single spine stripe; larger footer socials. The walkman send reveal is untouched in both.
